about.en: TBT is the ProShares UltraShort 20+ Year Treasury, a leveraged inverse exchange-traded fund that seeks daily investment results equal to two times the inverse (-2x) of the daily performance of the ICE U.S. Treasury 20+ Year Bond Index. It rises when long-dated Treasury prices fall, and because leverage resets daily, returns over periods longer than one day can differ significantly from -2x the index. Its shares trade on NYSE Arca.
